lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.
The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje bhagat kare din raatee aape bhagat karaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te vichhuRe tinee dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.
Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: mathe kaale mahal na paavahi dukh hee vich dukh paaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavahi sad hee sachai mel milaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no sachaa dei s paae ||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.
His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachai kaa aape daataa jis devai so sach paaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||
He Himself is the Creator of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aap bujhaae boojhai koee ||
lines.translation: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee aape mel milaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union. ||8||
Acting egotistically, one loses his life.
Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: agai jamakaal lekhaa levai jiu til ghaanee peeRaaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes him like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||
By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.
If God grants His Grace, then one serves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal tis neR na aavai mahal sachai sukh paaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin sukh paaiaa jo tudh bhaae ||
lines.translation: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.
By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: terai hath hai sabh vadiaaee jis devahi so paaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||11||
Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.
The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: giaan ratan sadaa ghat chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||12||
The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.
The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: chaladiaa ghar dar nadar na aavai jam dar baadhaa dukh paaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.
Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve tis milai vadiaaee dar sachai sobhaa paaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur no seve tis aap milaae ||
lines.translation: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.
Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach vanajahi vaapaaree naamo laahaa paaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||
The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidaa ||16||5||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh karanaa so kar paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, is done.
How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanaa ma(n)ne so sukh paae bhaane vich sukh paaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will. ||1||
Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.
Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaane no lochai bahuteree aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrender to His Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa bhaanaa ma(n)ne s milai tudh aae ||
lines.translation: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord.
